Ousted Ukraine Defense Minister Launches New Tech Firm with Palantir CEO Backing

Ukraine's former pro-technology Defense Minister has launched a new company focused on defense technology. The venture is backed by Alex Karp, the CEO of Palantir Technologies. The former minister was previously removed from his position.
